case.summary: Alert HHG-009 was initiated when cardholder C08299 disputed online transaction 3581141 for $30.02, stating they did not authorize the charge. The flagged transaction yielded a high fraud model score of 0.984 (92.1% historical fraud rate) and took place in region 203, where the cardholder had zero prior transaction history. Further examination revealed two subsequent suspicious online transactions on 2016-12-30 with high model scores, bringing the total unauthorized exposure to $70.11. The alert was confirmed as card-not-present fraud under Rule R2 based on decisive customer denial and corroborating model and regional anomalies.
